name: Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX) CKAN API

provider.name: UN OCHA Centre for Humanitarian Data

summary: Keyless CKAN API for HDX: thousands of humanitarian datasets on crises, health, food security, displacement and population.
description: HDX is a CKAN-based open data platform run by UN OCHA. package_search and package_show return dataset metadata, resources and licences; organization_list and group endpoints list contributing organisations and countries. The separate HAPI API needs a free app identifier and was not verified.

example.response_excerpt: {"help": "https://data.humdata.org/api/3/action/help_show?name=package_search", "success": true, "result": {"count": 90, "facets": {}, "expanded": {}, "results": [{"name": "drc-health-facilities", "title": "DRC Health Data Ebola 2018"}], "sort": "score desc, last_modified desc", "search_facets": {"pivot": {}, "queries": []}, "facet_pivot": {}, "facet_queries": {}}}

license.name: Varies per dataset (e.g. Open Database License for the example)

agent_notes: Standard CKAN action API; use rows and start to page and fq for filters like organization or groups (country). Each resource has a download url; read license_title per dataset. Data in resources is mostly CSV/XLSX/GeoJSON files, not queryable via the API.
caveats: HDX's own developer FAQ (/faqs/devs) returned 202 without content to curl, so the CKAN docs are linked instead.
The HAPI v2 API returned 403 'Invalid app identifier' without an identifier and was not verified.
Licences and terms vary per dataset; the terms page was not readable.
